gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Goldman spreads its wide letters out with a big, confident lowercase. Noto Sans Arabic takes over below in sans-serif, small letters opening wide, a pronounced x-height carrying long stretches of text smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Wide-set letters with generous clearance give Goldman a bold, commanding stance. And Noto Sans Cherokee, with a tall letter band and a wide-gapped e, brings an approachable counterweight to all that swagger.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Tidy and unfussy, with ascenders hugging the x-height line and generously opened s curves. Noto Sans Lisu would hold up page after page without fuss, leaving Goldman's wide bold letters to do the talking.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Big, bold, and spaced out: Goldman sets wide letters with generous clearance above Noto Sans Malayalam, whose middle zone dominates each line. Its generous s bends make long reading feel unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Goldman's lowercase stands unusually big against its capitals. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, with cracked-bangle rounds and large lowercase eyes, adds a modern counterpoint that makes the pair feel current.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Loud and wide: Goldman spreads bold letters with room to spare and a lowercase that towers. But Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, so pages of it feel clear and modern.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so none ever bump together. Against Goldman's bold, widely set letters, that tall, sturdy lowercase and its open curves give the combination its main appeal.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro makes words look dense and tall through the middle. Noto Sans Mro is the workhorse with generous letter entrances, while Goldman does its best work being wide and commanding.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Commanding, wide-set Goldman leads the way here. Noto Sans Nag Mundari brings curves that look half unwrapped and a lowercase rivaling the capitals, so the reading keeps moving along.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Wide and swaggering, Goldman spreads its letters out with room to spare. Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its chunky, tall lowercase and open-mouthed curves clear, so text stays approachable line after line.
